## Bug summary

What failed?

## Expected behavior

What should have happened?

## Actual behavior

What happened instead?

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest reproducible sequence, including relevant commit / branch / input classification.

## Input classification

- [ ] Synthetic fixture
- [ ] Existing regression material
- [ ] New unseen material
- [ ] Public financial filing
- [ ] Other

If the material has been inspected before, do not describe it as unseen.

## Logs / screenshots

Remove API keys, tokens, personal data, licensed research, and confidential financial material before posting.

## Affected layer

- [ ] Parser / extraction
- [ ] Evidence binding
- [ ] Deterministic calculation / chain
- [ ] LLM memo / validation
- [ ] Human review / versioning
- [ ] UI
- [ ] CI / build / tooling

## Core-logic impact

Would the proposed fix change `Claim`, `Assumption`, `Kill Criteria`, `Formula`, `Valuation`, or `Decision` definitions?

- [ ] No
- [ ] Possibly / Yes — stop at diagnosis until explicit approval is obtained
